subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should the supported CLI contract permit clearing a provider’s cached cookie when immediate browser re-import is unavailable, relying on a later packaged-app refresh to restore it?
rationale: This is a new user-facing authentication-recovery behavior with a deliberate compatibility tradeoff; source-level tests cannot determine whether temporary credential removal is the intended product contract.

options.title: Require immediate import success
options.body: Do not clear the existing cache unless the CLI can complete browser import and store a replacement credential in the same invocation.

options.title: Keep the pending-reimport contract
options.body: Allow clearing when import cannot run, but expose a distinct non-success status and document that the packaged app must complete recovery.

recommendation.title: Require immediate import success
recommendation.body: Do not clear the existing cache unless the CLI can complete browser import and store a replacement credential in the same invocation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history places steipete closest to the current cookie-refresh and Keychain-gating design.
